name: cowart-thinking-canvas
description: A source-grounded, non-linear thinking canvas with reversible agent edits and annotation-driven reasoning.

interface.shortDescription: Think with sources, editable visuals, and reversible annotation-driven agent edits.
interface.longDescription: Yogurt AI extends the tldraw-powered Cowart workspace with source-aware material cards, compact canvas context, atomic reasoning operations, guarded undo, selected-region annotation, and whole-canvas HTML or PowerPoint export.
defaultPrompt: Open Yogurt AI for this project.
Organize these documents into source-linked cards and relationships on the canvas.
Interpret my selected canvas annotations and apply the smallest reversible edit.
Use my Yogurt AI annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Yogurt AI image holder.
